reported_results.text: Most weight reduction with caloric restriction, including with pharmacotherapy, is attributable to reduction in body fat mass; the remainder (approximately 25–40%) can be attributed to lean tissues, including A full list of affiliations appears at the end of the paper.

The least squares mean absolute changes in body weight at week 48 were −9.3 kg (bimagrumab 30 mg kg−1), −14.2 kg (semaglutide 2.4 mg) and −17.8 kg (bimagrumab 30 mg kg−1 plus semaglutide 2.4 mg—that is, high-dose combination) versus −3.3 kg (placebo) (all P < 0.001 versus placebo).
At week 72, LSM percent reductions in total body fat mass were −28.5% (bimagrumab 30 mg kg−1), −27.8% (semaglutide 2.4 mg) and −45.7% (high-dose combination) (Fig. 3c).
Mean percent body fat decreased from 43.7% at baseline to 32.5% at week 48 with high-dose combination compared to 41.9% to 37.9% with semaglutide 2.4 mg.
At week 72, the LSM percent reductions in hsCRP were −72.0% (bimagrumab 30 mg kg−1), −59.3% (semaglutide 2.4 mg) and −84.0% (high-dose combination) (Fig. 3f).
At week 72, LSM percent changes in LDL cholesterol were 17.6% (bimagrumab 30 mg kg−1), −8.9% (semaglutide 2.4 mg) and 0.1% (high-dose combination) (Extended Data Fig. 6).
